theme.styleGuide:
Velvet Summit is a builtin QoderWork AI Slides visual reference. Match its deep plum-black velvet scheme, ceremonial restraint, and luxurious, high-end, premium-brand tone while using the bundled Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0 font stack for generated slides.
Reference typography cues: display: Playfair Display; heading: Playfair Display; body: DM Sans; mono: Courier Prime; serif_cn: Noto Serif SC; sans_cn: Noto Sans SC. Treat these font names as visual cues, not external font dependencies.
Color language: deep plum-black canvas (#1A0E1C) with warm cream body type (#F5EDE0) and a strictly rationed champagne-gold (#D4AF6A / #E5C687) reserved for headline serifs, hero numbers, and hairline rules; a single coherent dark palette across every slide, no inverted theme.
Best for: Luxury and premium consumer brand pitches, hospitality and lifestyle ventures, flagship product reveals, and high-end partnership and sponsorship proposals — fundraising decks and business plans that must feel ceremonial, expensive, and quietly confident.
Reference notes: A black-tie pitch deck rendered as a velvet gala programme. Every slide is the same deep plum-black field (#1A0E1C) with a subtly warmer plum surface (#241428) for occasional panels. Champagne-gold Playfair Display serifs carry every headline and every hero number — the gold is the ceremony, and it is spent sparingly: on the title, the one big market figure, the traction stats, and thin 1px gold hairlines. Cream DM Sans (#F5EDE0) does the reading work in a calm supporting voice; a muted warm taupe (#A89F9B) handles secondary copy. Courier Prime mono provides the ledger voice — kickers, page numbers, and a fixed company mark (VELVET / SUMMIT CAPITAL) sitting in the deck chrome. There are no drop shadows and no gradients beyond one faint radial glow behind the cover title; corners stay crisp, borders are 1px gold at low opacity. The mood is a private members' club meets a fundraising roadshow — slow, luxurious, ceremonial. One field, one gold accent, spent like it costs something.

decorativePatterns.name: visual-system
decorativePatterns.description:
Deep plum-black canvas with champagne-gold serifs and cream type. Luxurious, ceremonial, high-end brand gravitas.
A deep plum-black velvet field (#1A0E1C) carries every slide, with a subtly warmer plum surface (#241428) reserved for compare panels and the ask card. Champagne-gold (#D4AF6A, brightened to #E5C687 for emphasis) is rationed to headline serifs, hero numbers, traction stats, and 1px hairline rules — the restraint is the luxury.
Playfair Display serifs at display and hero scale supply the ceremonial pitch-deck gravitas; DM Sans carries body in cream (#F5EDE0), a muted taupe (#A89F9B) handles secondary copy, and Courier Prime mono provides kickers, page numbers, and the fixed SUMMIT CAPITAL company mark in the chrome; bilingual EN/CN support via Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC fallbacks.
Depth is flat and ceremonial: no drop shadows, no rounded corners, no gradients beyond a single faint radial gold glow behind the cover title. Borders are 1px champagne-gold at ~20% opacity — present as fine structural rules rather than heavy dividers. The compare layout is the one exception, using two adjacent plum shades to split the canvas. Motion is set to zero — the deck is completely still, like a printed gala programme.
Key characteristics: single plum-black field on every slide; champagne-gold spent only on titles, hero numbers, stats, and hairlines; oversized Playfair serif headlines and market figures for pitch-deck presence; per-slide chrome with company mark and page number.
